_comment: Approximate per-file test durations in milliseconds, keyed by path relative to e2e/testcases. Used by compute-shard-plan.ts to bin-pack files across CI shards by estimated cost instead of alphabetical file count. Entries marked as measured come from real CTRF/report.json data pulled from CI runs; everything else falls back to DEFAULT_WEIGHT_MS in compute-shard-plan.ts (the median of the measured set) until it's replaced with a real measurement.
